 Monaco have two wins, one draw and two defeats from their last five competitive games. Most recently, they lost 3-1 to Paris FC in Ligue 1. Their results also include a convincing 3-0 Conference League win against SC Freiburg and a 2-1 away victory at CSKA Sofia. Across those five games, Monaco scored eight goals and conceded five.
 Nordsjælland have one win, three draws and one defeat from their last five matches. They lost their most recent game 3-2 to FC Midtjylland in the Superliga. In the Conference League, they most recently drew 2-2 against CSKA Sofia. Across those five matches, Nordsjælland scored nine goals and conceded ten.
